messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT detected: continuous-batching latency and error spike for us-east-1. Autoscaler reports KV cache eviction rate > 90% and batch timeouts spiking. Link: https://internal/alerts/3512346789

maria: paging @casey_oncall and @devon — looks like customer-facing endpoints are seeing 5xxs and slow tails.

casey_oncall: on it. ETA 5. grabbing logs now. any customer impact flagged?

csm_jordan: i've got one customer (acme-inc) reporting increased error rates since ~09:02 UTC, they say API calls returning 503 intermittently.

devon: attaching a short grep of runtime logs from one affected replica:

```
2026-03-15T09:02:11.234Z WARN batcher: request timeout after 12000ms, seq_count=128, batch_tokens=4800
2026-03-15T09:02:12.003Z ERROR kvcache: eviction loop detected: evict_count=1450, pool_available=2
2026-03-15T09:02:13.112Z WARN runtime: kv-page-miss thrash, paging_ops=900/s
```

devon: looks like continuous-batching config may be overshooting max_batch_tokens or max_num_seqs leading to cache amplification and paging.

casey_oncall: can we triage which config changed recently? Any deploys to cont-batcher or kvcache?

eng_ops: deploy-bot: Recent deploy to cont-batcher pool us-east-1 at 08:58 (rev: cb-2.7.4). No kvcache changes listed in last 24h.

sre_lead: devon, can you confirm the running values for the pool? specifically max_batch_tokens, max_num_seqs, and batch_timeout_ms.

devon: current effective config (from sharded config service):

```
cont_batch.max_batch_tokens = 65536
cont_batch.max_num_seqs = 256
cont_batch.batch_timeout_ms = 12000
kvcache.pool_size = 48
kvcache.max_pages = 1024
```

devon: those max_batch_tokens and max_num_seqs are much higher than historical defaults. looks like a policy override landed in the pool-tier config at 08:50.

maria: that matches the timeline (customer issues at ~09:02). change approved by platform-sig, but maybe not tested on high-shared workloads.

casey_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) roll the cont-batcher rev back to previous safe config OR 2) hotpatch config to reduce max_batch_tokens and max_num_seqs and lower timeout. preference for minimal blast radius: patch config.

devon: proposed hotfix: set max_batch_tokens=16384, max_num_seqs=64, batch_timeout_ms=3000. This reduces KV cache working set and batch tail.

sre_lead: agree. do we have a quick canary rollout path? we should patch one AZ first.

eng_ops: running patch: applying config to cb-pool-us-east-1a (canary) now. Command:

```
./ctl config set cont_batch.max_batch_tokens=16384 --pool cb-pool-us-east-1a
./ctl config set cont_batch.max_num_seqs=64 --pool cb-pool-us-east-1a
./ctl config set cont_batch.batch_timeout_ms=3000 --pool cb-pool-us-east-1a
```

eng_ops: canary applied. observing metrics.

maria: routing note: traffic is split 80/20 between AZs. keep eyes on error rate and latency.

(devon updates dashboards)

devon: canary metrics (1m after): kv-evictions down 70% on canary nodes, paging_ops down 65%, 5xxs on canary reduced to baseline.

casey_oncall: good. start incremental rollout to other AZs, 1 at a time, 2m observation windows.

eng_ops: rolling to cb-pool-us-east-1b. patching.

csm_jordan: communicating to acme: "we identified a configuration regression impacting continuous batching leading to KV cache pressure. We have deployed a mitigative config and are monitoring. We will follow up with root cause and timeline."

maria: customer comms approved by legal. please log support ticket and mark as SEV-2.

eng_ops: rollout completed to all AZs. final check: kv-evictions back to normal, avg token latency improved ~30%, error rate normalized.

sre_lead: next steps: 1) revert the platform-tier override that introduced the high defaults, 2) add a guardrail in config service to block max_batch_tokens > 32768 for shared pools, 3) postmortem and RCA.

devon: capturing a snapshot of the offending override audit record:

```
2026-03-15T08:50:03Z config-service: override set by service-account:platform-sig -- key cont_batch.max_batch_tokens=65536 -- scope pool-tier
```

casey_oncall: handoff: i'm signing off in 15m. @devon you will own the RCA and followup?

devon: i'm owning the RCA and the guardrail ticket. expected ETA for RCA draft: EOD.

maria: great. incident-bot, please create incident record and page postmortem channel.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-15-3512346789. Postmortem: https://internal/postmortems/INC-3512346789

csm_jordan: letting acme know resolution complete. will follow up about SLA impact and credits if any.

sre_lead: retrospective notes to include: a) why override bypassed canary tests, b) missing config validation for shared pools, c) runbook updates to reduce recovery time.

casey_oncall: handing off to devon for RCA and remediation work. signing out. :wave:

devon: acknowledged. creating follow-up tickets: 1) config-guardrail (P0), 2) rollback audit & alerting (P1), 3) improved canary checks for cont-batcher (P1).
